phase_title: 検証失敗時の差し戻し・NO-GO維持ルール設計
phase_purpose: Phase 16 実測入力データエントリ受領・検証層：Phase 16-4（形式検証）または Phase 16-2（完全性・署名・整合性検証）で失敗した場合、データを差し戻す手順と、integrated_decision・receiver_validator_permission が NO_GO・NOT_EFFECTIVE のままであることを保証するルールを設計する
execution_context: reports-only design phase; design of validation failure handling and return procedures only, no actual failure handling yet

governance.safety_rule: All blocked_actions remain strictly prohibited. Validation failure handling is design-only; no actual failure response procedures are executed. No app/tests implementation permitted. NO_GO status must be maintained throughout failure scenarios.
governance.hard_stop_condition: This phase is design-only. No actual data return, status updates, or remediation actions are permitted.

examples: Field type mismatch (string expected, number received)
One or more required fields empty
Reviewer's key/certificate not found or expired
Reviewer ID mismatch (15-1 and 15-2 from different uncoordinated reviewers)
Decision logic violation (integrated_decision NO_GO but permission EFFECTIVE)

return_eligible_failures.definition: Failures where human reviewer can correct the submission and resubmit

categorization.reason: Reviewer can reformat data, fix field values, resubmit
Reviewer can provide missing fields, resubmit
Reviewer can reconcile decisions, coordinate timestamps, resubmit

halt_non_returnable_failures.definition: Failures that indicate structural problems or tampering; cannot be resolved by reviewer alone

categorization.reason: Indicates authentication system issue or tampering; escalate to authority
Indicates potential malicious tampering; must be investigated by security team

return_procedure_for_returnable_failures.return_procedure_name: Validation Failure Return and Correction Workflow

return_steps.action: Classify failure into category (form, completeness, consistency, etc.)
Determine if failure is returnable (reviewer can correct) or halt-required (needs escalation)
return_steps.logic: If returnable: proceed to step RETURN_3; if halt-required: proceed to step HALT_1

return_steps.action: Create detailed return report listing all validation failures and correction instructions
report_contents: List of failing fields with current values

return_steps.action: Notify reviewer of validation failure and return report via established channel (email, form portal, etc.)
notification_contents: Validation failed; data returned for corrections
Return report attached with specific issues
return_steps.requirement: Notification must be authenticated and timestamped

return_steps.action: Store failed submission in archive with return report for audit trail

archive_structure.reviewer_notified: boolean - confirmation that reviewer was contacted

return_steps.action: Ensure integrated_decision and receiver_validator_permission remain NO_GO and NOT_EFFECTIVE
return_steps.enforcement: Do not proceed to Phase 15-7 or Phase 15-8; no measurement until corrected data passes validation
return_steps.requirement: Status lock file must document that data is in RETURNED state

return_steps.action: Wait for reviewer to resubmit corrected data
return_steps.state: In RETURN state; Phase 16-1 receipt and validation cycle restart upon resubmission
return_steps.max_wait_period: Resubmission deadline (e.g., 5 business days); if exceeded, escalate

original_submission_reference.type: string - reference to original Phase 16-1 receipt

elements.failure_categories: List of failure categories (FORM, COMPLETENESS, CONSISTENCY, etc.)
elements.critical_failures: List of failures that block progression (non-correctable)

contents: For each failure: specific correction needed
Reference to Phase 15-1 or 15-2 format specification

elements.deadline: Date/time by which corrected data must be resubmitted
elements.submission_channel: Same channel as original (Phase 16-1 receipt channel)
elements.required_acknowledgment: Reviewer must acknowledge receipt of return report

status_after_return.implication: integrated_decision remains NO_GO; receiver_validator_permission remains NOT_EFFECTIVE; Phase 15-7 and 15-8 cannot execute

halt_procedure_for_non_returnable_failur.halt_procedure_name: Validation Failure Escalation and Halt Workflow

halt_steps.action: Confirm failure is non-returnable (authentication failure, tampering detection, etc.)
failure_types: AUTHENTICATION_FAILURES (signature invalid, weak algorithm, key invalid)

halt_steps.blocking: Do not proceed to Phase 16-2 validation, Phase 16-3 assessment, Phase 15-7, or Phase 15-8
halt_steps.requirement: Processing must halt within seconds of failure detection

halt_steps.action: Alert security team, Phase 16 authority, and audit function
alert_contents: Specific failure details (signature invalid, hash mismatch, etc.)

halt_steps.action: Preserve all data, audit logs, and evidence for investigation
Present issue to human authority for investigation and decision
escalation_package: Possible causes (malicious tampering, system error, clock issue, etc.)
Options: request resubmission, deep investigation, reject submission

halt_steps.action: Ensure integrated_decision and receiver_validator_permission remain NO_GO and NOT_EFFECTIVE
halt_steps.enforcement: Document halted state; Phase 15-7 and 15-8 cannot execute until human authority authorizes proceeding
halt_steps.requirement: Status lock must be explicit: HALTED_PENDING_INVESTIGATION

halt_steps.action: Wait for human authority decision on how to proceed
halt_steps.state: In HALTED state; awaiting human review and decision
possible_outcomes: APPROVED_TO_REQUEST_RESUBMISSION: Contact reviewer, request new submission
APPROVED_TO_REJECT_SUBMISSION: Reject data permanently, no resubmission
APPROVED_FOR_DEEP_INVESTIGATION: Launch security investigation before proceeding
APPROVED_WITH_OVERRIDE: In rare cases, authority may override failure (not recommended)

elements: Evidence of violation (e.g., stored hash vs current hash)
Possible root causes (malicious, accidental, system error, clock issue)
Impact assessment (how does this affect Phase 15-7/15-8 measurement?)
Audit log preserved: yes/no, date range

status_after_halt.implication: integrated_decision remains NO_GO; receiver_validator_permission remains NOT_EFFECTIVE; Phase 15-7 and 15-8 cannot execute until authority decides

no_go_maintenance_rules.rule: integrated_decision and receiver_validator_permission must remain NO_GO and NOT_EFFECTIVE if validation fails

enforcement_points.requirement: Lock status to RETURNED_FOR_CORRECTION; block Phase 15-7 and 15-8 execution
Maintain NO_GO/NOT_EFFECTIVE; do not update statuses
Lock status to HALTED_PENDING_INVESTIGATION; block all downstream processing
Maintain NO_GO/NOT_EFFECTIVE; do not update statuses without explicit authority approval
Start new Phase 16-1 receipt and validation cycle; use no cached state from failed submission

failure_tracking_and_auditing.failure_tracking_purpose: Maintain complete record of all validation failures, returns, and escalations

report_content: Summary of validation failures in period
Failure breakdown by type (form, completeness, consistency, authentication, integrity)
Resubmission success rate (% that passed after return)
Root cause analysis of frequent failure types

depends_on: Phase 16-4: Format validation (triggers returns/halts if failed)
Phase 16-2: Completeness, signature, consistency validation (triggers returns/halts if failed)
Phase 16-5: Evidence lock and integrity verification (triggers halts if tampering detected)
feeds_into: Phase 16-1: Upon resubmission, starts new receipt and validation cycle
Phase 16-3: Only proceeds if no returns or halts (validation passed)
Phase 15-7: Only executes if all validation passed and NO_GO/NOT_EFFECTIVE status maintained
Phase 15-8: Only executes if all validation passed and NO_GO/NOT_EFFECTIVE status maintained

design_review_checklist: Validation failure scenarios are comprehensive (form, completeness, authentication, consistency, integrity)
Return vs halt classification clearly separates returnable from non-returnable failures
Return procedure provides clear correction instructions to reviewer
Return report structure captures all necessary failure and correction information
Resubmission deadline is specified (e.g., 5 business days)
Halt procedure includes immediate security alert and forensic evidence preservation
Escalation report structure supports human authority decision-making
NO_GO maintenance rules ensure integrated_decision and receiver_validator_permission remain NO_GO throughout failure scenario
Phase 15-7 and 15-8 measurement workflows cannot execute if validation fails (blocking enforcement)
Failure tracking maintains audit trail of all validations, returns, escalations
Archive of failed submissions is preserved for investigation
Design acknowledges this is design-only; actual return/halt mechanisms TBD for implementation
All blocked actions remain in governance

completion_gate.gate_condition: Failure handling design approved AND return/halt procedures specified AND NO_GO maintenance rules enforced
completion_gate.approval_required: Human technical reviewer + Phase 16 design authority
completion_gate.prerequisite_for: Phase 16-1 through 16-6 complete; ready for human review approval and next phase planning
